targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Tautulli 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'stream_count')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Jellyfin 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'stream_count')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Tautulli 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'total_bandwidth')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Sonarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Radarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Radarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Lidarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Lidarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Readarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Readarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Sonarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ok' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'unknown' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Radarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Radarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ok' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'unknown' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Lidarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Lidarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ok' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'unknown' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Readarr 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'size')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Readarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ok' AND tags->>'tracked_download_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'unknown' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Overseerr 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'pending')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Overseerr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Request_Counts' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Ombi 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'pending')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Ombi' AND tags->>'type' = 'Request_Counts' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Bazarr 1 movies' AS metric, last((fields->>'movies')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Bazarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'WantedTotal' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('30s', time) AS time, 'Bazarr 1 episodes' AS metric, last((fields->>'episodes')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Bazarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'WantedTotal' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '90 seconds' GROUP BY 1) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_bucket('60s', time) AS time, 'collectors' AS metric, last((fields->>'collectors')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Varken' AND tags->>'type' = 'Status' AND time > now() - interval '180 seconds' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('60s', time) AS time, 'collectors_open' AS metric, last((fields->>'collectors_open')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Varken' AND tags->>'type' = 'Status' AND time > now() - interval '180 seconds' GROUP BY 1) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT tags->>'username' AS "username", tags->>'title' AS "title", tags->>'video_decision' AS "video_decision", tags->>'quality' AS "quality", last((fields->>'progress')::double precision, time) AS "progress" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'Session' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'username', tags->>'title', tags->>'video_decision', tags->>'quality'

SELECT tags->>'username' AS "username", tags->>'title' AS "title", tags->>'video_decision' AS "video_decision", tags->>'quality' AS "quality", last((fields->>'progress_percent')::double precision, time) AS "progress" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'Session' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'username', tags->>'title', tags->>'video_decision', tags->>'quality'

SELECT tags->>'username' AS "username", tags->>'title' AS "title", tags->>'video_decision' AS "video_decision", tags->>'quality' AS "quality", last((fields->>'progress_percent')::double precision, time) AS "progress" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'Session' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'username', tags->>'title', tags->>'video_decision', tags->>'quality'

SELECT tags->>'full_location' AS "full_location", tags->>'username' AS "username", last((fields->>'lat')::double precision, time) AS "lat", last((fields->>'lon')::double precision, time) AS "lon" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'Session' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'full_location', tags->>'username'

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Tautulli 1' AS metric, avg((fields->>'stream_count')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Jellyfin 1' AS metric, avg((fields->>'stream_count')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Emby 1' AS metric, avg((fields->>'stream_count')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Tautulli 1 LAN' AS metric, avg((fields->>'lan_bandwidth')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Tautulli 1 WAN' AS metric, avg((fields->>'wan_bandwidth')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Plex 1 CPU' AS metric, avg((fields->>'process_cpu_percent')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Plex' AND tags->>'type' = 'Resources' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, 'Plex 1 RAM' AS metric, avg((fields->>'process_memory_percent')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Plex' AND tags->>'type' = 'Resources' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT tags->>'name' AS "name", tags->>'sxe' AS "sxe", tags->>'tracked_download_status' AS "tracked_download_status", last((fields->>'progress')::double precision, time) AS "progress", last((fields->>'sizeleft')::double precision, time) AS "sizeleft" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'name', tags->>'sxe', tags->>'tracked_download_status'

SELECT tags->>'name' AS "name", tags->>'tracked_download_status' AS "tracked_download_status", last((fields->>'progress')::double precision, time) AS "progress", last((fields->>'sizeleft')::double precision, time) AS "sizeleft" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Radarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'name', tags->>'tracked_download_status'

SELECT tags->>'name' AS "name", tags->>'tracked_download_status' AS "tracked_download_status", last((fields->>'progress')::double precision, time) AS "progress", last((fields->>'sizeleft')::double precision, time) AS "sizeleft" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Lidarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'name', tags->>'tracked_download_status'

SELECT tags->>'name' AS "name", tags->>'tracked_download_status' AS "tracked_download_status", last((fields->>'progress')::double precision, time) AS "progress", last((fields->>'sizeleft')::double precision, time) AS "sizeleft" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Readarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Queue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '60 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'name', tags->>'tracked_download_status'

SELECT tags->>'name' AS "name", tags->>'sxe' AS "sxe", tags->>'airsUTC' AS "airsUTC", tags->>'downloaded' AS "downloaded", last(fields->>'hash', time) AS "hash" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Future' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '360 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'name', tags->>'sxe', tags->>'airsUTC', tags->>'downloaded'

SELECT tags->>'name' AS "name", tags->>'sxe' AS "sxe", tags->>'airsUTC' AS "airsUTC", tags->>'downloaded' AS "downloaded", last(fields->>'hash', time) AS "hash" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Missing' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '360 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'name', tags->>'sxe', tags->>'airsUTC', tags->>'downloaded'

SELECT tags->>'title' AS "title", tags->>'requested_user' AS "requested_user", tags->>'requested_date' AS "requested_date", tags->>'status' AS "status", last(fields->>'hash', time) AS "hash" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Overseerr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Requests' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '360 seconds' GROUP BY tags->>'title', tags->>'requested_user', tags->>'requested_date', tags->>'status'

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Sonarr 1 ' || (tags->>'path') AS metric, last((fields->>'free_bytes')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'RootFolder' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'path' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Radarr 1 ' || (tags->>'path') AS metric, last((fields->>'free_bytes')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Radarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'RootFolder' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'path' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Lidarr 1 ' || (tags->>'path') AS metric, last((fields->>'free_bytes')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Lidarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'RootFolder' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'path' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Readarr 1 ' || (tags->>'path') AS metric, last((fields->>'free_bytes')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Readarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'RootFolder' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'path' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Sonarr 1 · ' || (tags->>'level') || ' · ' || (tags->>'source') AS metric, count(fields->>'message') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Sonarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HealthIssue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'level', tags->>'source' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Radarr 1 · ' || (tags->>'level') || ' · ' || (tags->>'source') AS metric, count(fields->>'message') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Radarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HealthIssue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'level', tags->>'source' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Lidarr 1 · ' || (tags->>'level') || ' · ' || (tags->>'source') AS metric, count(fields->>'message') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Lidarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HealthIssue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'level', tags->>'source' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Readarr 1 · ' || (tags->>'level') || ' · ' || (tags->>'source') AS metric, count(fields->>'message') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Readarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HealthIssue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'level', tags->>'source' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Prowlarr 1 · ' || (tags->>'level') || ' · ' || (tags->>'source') AS metric, count(fields->>'message') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Prowlarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HealthIssue' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'level', tags->>'source' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('300s', time) AS time, 'Bazarr 1 · ' || (tags->>'provider') || ' · ' || (tags->>'status') AS metric, last((fields->>'throttled')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Bazarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Provider' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND (fields->>'throttled')::double precision = 1 AND time > now() - interval '900 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'provider', tags->>'status' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('60s', time) AS time, 'Varken · ' || (tags->>'plugin') || ' ' || (tags->>'server') || ' · ' || (tags->>'collector') || ' circuit' AS metric, last((fields->>'consecutive_errors')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Varken' AND tags->>'type' = 'Collector' AND (fields->>'circuit_state')::double precision > 0 AND time > now() - interval '180 seconds' GROUP BY 1, tags->>'plugin', tags->>'server', tags->>'collector' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, (tags->>'media_type') || ' · Tautulli 1' AS metric, count((fields->>'play_duration_seconds')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'Play' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, tags->>'media_type' ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, 'Jellyfin 1' AS metric, count(fields->>'hash') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'Activity' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'activity_type' = 'VideoPlayback' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, 'Emby 1' AS metric, count(fields->>'hash') AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'Activity' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'activity_type' = 'VideoPlayback' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY time

SELECT tags->>'username' AS "username", count((fields->>'play_duration_seconds')::double precision) AS "plays" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'Play' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY tags->>'username'

SELECT extract(isodow from time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS weekday, extract(hour from time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hour, count((fields->>'play_duration_seconds')::double precision) AS count FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'Play' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT extract(isodow from time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS weekday, extract(hour from time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hour, count(fields->>'hash') AS count FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'Activity' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'activity_type' = 'VideoPlayback' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT extract(isodow from time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS weekday, extract(hour from time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hour, count(fields->>'hash') AS count FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'Activity' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND tags->>'activity_type' = 'VideoPlayback' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT tags->>'rating_key' AS "rating_key", count(fields->>'hash') AS "plays", last(fields->>'title', time) AS "title" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'Play' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY tags->>'rating_key'

SELECT * FROM (SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Direct play' AS metric, sum((fields->>'direct_play_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Direct stream' AS metric, sum((fields->>'direct_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Transcode' AS metric, sum((fields->>'transcode_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time)) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Direct play' AS metric, sum((fields->>'direct_play_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Direct stream' AS metric, sum((fields->>'direct_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Transcode' AS metric, sum((fields->>'transcode_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Jellyfin' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time)) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Direct play' AS metric, sum((fields->>'direct_play_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Direct stream' AS metric, sum((fields->>'direct_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT min(time) AS time, 'Transcode' AS metric, sum((fields->>'transcode_streams')::double precision) * 30 AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Emby' AND tags->>'type' = 'current_stream_stats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time)) AS u ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "Time", fields->>'title' AS "title", tags->>'library_name' AS "library_name", tags->>'media_type' AS "media_type" FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Tautulli' AND tags->>'type' = 'RecentlyAdded' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (SELECT time, metric, value - lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS value FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, 'Overseerr 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'total')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Overseerr' AND tags->>'type' = 'Request_Counts' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) AS a) AS d WHERE value >= 0 ORDER BY time

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (SELECT time, metric, value - lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS value FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, 'Ombi 1' AS metric, last((fields->>'total')::double precision, time) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Ombi' AND tags->>'type' = 'Request_Total' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) AS a) AS d WHERE value >= 0 ORDER BY time

SELECT * FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, 'Movies' AS metric, sum((fields->>'movies')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Bazarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HistoryStats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket('1d', time) AS time, 'Episodes' AS metric, sum((fields->>'episodes')::double precision) AS value FROM varken_events WHERE measurement = 'Bazarr' AND tags->>'type' = 'HistoryStats' AND tags->>'server' = '1' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1) AS u ORDER BY time
